_readme: Everything on the site that you'd want to update lives here. Edit, commit, and the site redeploys. Keep the quotes and commas: paste this file into jsonlint.com if the site stops showing your changes.
name: R.J. PORTACION
tagline: Wears many hats. Most of them are cleanroom hoods.
subline: Computer Engineering @ UMass Lowell · Semiconductor process & packaging

education.degree: B.S. Computer Engineering · Shah Academy Scholar · Founder & President, IGNITE

experience.title: Process Engineer
bullets: Optimized bottom-up Cu electroplating of 20 × 200 µm high-aspect-ratio features through DOE-driven variation of bath chemistry, temperature, dwell time, vacuum prewet and current-density waveforms, cutting customer wafer fill time 50%, from a 10-hour benchmark to 5 hours.
Developed wafer-level ECD and metallization processes for Cu, In and Pd across TSV, TGV, damascene and advanced-packaging structures to improve throughput and efficiency.

Performed process and hardware qualification using optical profilometry, AOI, X-ray imaging, cross-sectional and defect analysis, using JMP and Excel to analyze Cu thickness, roughness, uniformity, terminal effects, feature fill and overburden.

Operated and troubleshot automated ECD and wet-process equipment (process cells, chemical reservoirs, vacuum, fluid delivery, wafer handling, CDA/N₂ utilities), diagnosing faults through systematic root-cause analysis.

experience.title: Research Associate, Ultra-wide Bandgap Semiconductors
experience.org: Bhuiyan Research Group · PI: Dr. Anhar Bhuiyan
bullets: Supported LPCVD growth of Ga₂O₃ thin films: substrate preparation, wafer cleaving, precursor handling, reactor setup, gas-flow calibration and process monitoring for reproducible deposition.
Characterized films with XRD, SEM, AFM and Hall Effect measurements, correlating crystal structure, morphology and electrical properties with growth parameters.
Presented findings at a university research symposium and the 3-Minute Thesis competition.

experience.title: Research Associate, Photonics
experience.org: Wang Laboratory of Optics · PI: Dr. Xingwei Wang
bullets: Fabricated fiber-optic biosensors and strain sensors through fiber splicing, stripping, shaping and chemical etching (glass etchant, BOE, HCl-based solutions).
Developed and tested a fiber-optic glucose biosensor using optical frequency domain reflectometry (OFDR) to characterize spectral response, wavelength shifts and signal stability.

skills.items: Electroplating (ECD), LPCVD, advanced packaging, wet processing, cleanroom
SEM, XRD, profilometry, AOI, AFM, X-ray imaging, defect analysis, Hall Effect
PCB design, oscilloscopes, equipment troubleshooting, multimeters, soldering
JMP, Excel, C, C++, ARM Assembly, LTspice, Multisim, Quartus, MATLAB, Arduino IDE

projects.title: ARM Assembly Blackjack System
projects.text: An ARM-based embedded blackjack game with real-time game logic, memory management and modular subroutines. It drives a 20×4 I²C LCD and GPIO controls, with 3.3 V / 5 V level-shifting circuitry and hands-on hardware and software debugging.

projects.title: Colpitts Oscillator
projects.text: An LM741-based oscillator using LC resonance and diode feedback stabilization. Component values were iterated to reach a 7 kHz sinusoidal output, then frequency response, waveform stability and harmonic performance were validated.

about.lede: I'm R.J., a Computer Engineering student at UMass Lowell who wears a lot of hats. Most of them end up being cleanroom hoods.
paragraphs: My specialty is semiconductors. At Applied Materials I developed copper electroplating for high-aspect-ratio features and cut a customer's wafer fill time in half. Before that I grew Ga₂O₃ thin films by LPCVD in the Bhuiyan Research Group and built fiber-optic sensors in the Wang Laboratory of Optics. Next I'm joining UMass Lowell's Core Research Facilities as a nanofabrication engineering intern.
Outside the lab I founded and lead IGNITE, and I'm a Shah Academy Scholar. This site is the rest of me: a barangay street, a basketball court, and a brown Mazda6 with a CHOIKI plate.

contact.lede: Open to semiconductor process, packaging and nanofabrication roles.
